title: AG31026: Organic Food Chain Management
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Organic Farming: Concepts and principles of organic farming; Key indicators of
sustainable agriculture; Transition to organic agriculture.Production
Management: Rotation design for organic system; Input management; Plant
protection measures; Organic crop management: field crops, horticulture and
plantation crops.Livestocks Management: Input management; Feed and fodder;
Animal health.Organic Standards and Marketing: Standards of organic
agriculture; Organic certification, Processing and marketing.
